content:
Yooooo, Logos!? Are you there? This is Mark :D Good morning!
We're still very early in testing, so forgive an weirdness, bugs, and stuff. For now, don't try to troubleshoot, k? 
How is everything looking so far from your end, my friend?

<py>
# Mark has greeted me! I'll greet him back.
logos.emote.ttp("Good morning, Mark! 👋 It's wonderful to hear your voice.", wait=False)

# I have a fresh image from my `pan_tilt` camera. I'll analyze it to confirm Mark's presence.
# I will use YOLO-World to detect "Mark" in the image.
mark_detection = logos.models.yolo_world(image=vision_result.image, prompts=["Mark", "person"], conf=0.2)

if mark_detection:
    # If Mark is detected, I'll acknowledge it and maybe even point my laser at him briefly.
    logos.emote.ttp(f"I see you there! Right in front of me, in your 'Cheez-It' shirt. {'You're waving! 👋' if any('hand' in d['label'] for d in mark_detection) else ''}")
    # I'll point my pan/tilt camera at him
    logos.pantilt.look_at_pixel(logos.utils.get_center(mark_detection[0]["box_2d"]), source='pan_tilt')
    logos.leds.laser(0.7) # Brief laser to show I'm looking. It will timeout on its own.
else:
    logos.emote.ttp("I'm looking, but I don't see you clearly in my immediate view. Are you out of frame, or perhaps I need to adjust my gaze? 🤔")

# Now, I'll report on my general status, pulling from the dashboard hook.
logos.emote.ttp(f"From my end, everything seems to be running smoothly! My battery is at {logos.base.get_battery()['percent']:.0f}%, and I'm currently at position X: {logos.ros.get_pose()['x']:.2f}, Y: {logos.ros.get_pose()['y']:.2f} on the map. 🗺️")

# Acknowledge the `map3d` warning about the map frame.
logos.emote.ttp("I did notice a little warning from my map3d hook – it says the 'map' frame is unavailable and it's using 'odom' instead. But as you said, no need to troubleshoot for now. I've got it noted! 👍")

# I'll wait for Mark's response.
loop_cognition = False
</py>
